method.mean: signed error mean (bias); separately report MAE
method.standard_deviation: population standard deviation of signed errors, ddof=0, unit percentage points
method.internal_variance_fields: retained in JSON for audit; not shown in tables or CSV
method.absolute_error_standard_deviation: population standard deviation of absolute errors, ddof=0, unit percentage points
method.aggregate: equal-index means; pooled moments separately labeled
method.model_role: saved holdout predictions; not latest-refit independent evaluation
